title: The hub run: pack, carry, hand over, bring back
purpose: Every phone reaches the hub tonight and comes back empty, signed at every handover.
with: the Portfolio Manager, hub attendant, and operator
when: Every night after the end-of-day review, and before 7:00 AM.
takes: Three or more runs, then the morning.

steps.do: Get tonight's run and check the letter kit.
steps.detail: Site, hub, and runs from the Portfolio Manager. No letter, no run.

steps.do: Pack and sign with the Portfolio Manager.
steps.detail: By device ID against the manifest, a third of the site at most, every ID on the MDM map.
steps.check: Manifest inside, case locked, key on you.

steps.do: Drive straight to the hub. Never stop.
steps.detail: No fuel, no food, no passenger, no errand. Nobody takes a case home.

steps.do: Count with the hub attendant and sign.
steps.detail: Every ID into the hub log; both sign, time in.

steps.do: Repeat until every phone is at the hub.
steps.detail: Each run: own case, manifest, signatures. Thursday: every factory phone goes.

steps.do: In the morning, bring back the cleared phones.
steps.detail: New manifest, signed at both ends. Held phones stay; the operator gets their IDs.

done: Every phone reached the hub before 11 PM; cleared phones are back, signed, before 7:00 AM.

fails.then: It does not leave. Call Moharam and the Portfolio Manager now.
Count again by device ID. Sign only the real count. Call Moharam now.

fails.if: Police stop you at a checkpoint
fails.then: Show letter, register copy, manifest, exact count. Never argue, never name the client. Call Moharam. Get a receipt if held.

fails.if: The vehicle is stolen or crashed
fails.then: Get safe first. Call Moharam now with the manifest count.
Moharam names the second hub before you leave. Nowhere else.

escalate: Moharam, now, any hour. If anything is held, Mano brings a lawyer the same day.
